_comment: The inputs the placement, leak and e2e gates render with. Acme is not a
real store and never becomes one: this tree is placed into a temp
directory, asserted against, and deleted. The values are chosen to be
AWKWARD rather than tidy — a store name with an apostrophe and an
ampersand (both legal in the card's pattern, both special in TypeScript
strings and HTML), a hyphenated repo slug that CONTAINS this baseline's
own slug (`commerce`, an English word the rename must not chase twice),
an owner other than the baseline's, and a multi-label domain — because a
fixture that only uses values the templates were written against proves
the templates work on the values they were written against.
Every key here is an input repo-blueprint.yaml declares. A key it does not
declare is a fixture that has drifted, and orun refuses it.
